component.name: Dropshade
component.summary: A drop-down terminal that slides over your windows

description.p: Press a key and Dropshade slides down from the top of the screen; press it again and it is gone. It runs natively on Wayland, with a small GNOME Shell extension that places it, keeps it above other windows and animates it.

ul.li: Tabs that can be renamed, reordered and placed on any side of the window
Tabs and their directories come back after a restart; save sets of tabs as layouts
Themes, fonts, transparency and keybindings in one live-reloading config file
Kitty keyboard protocol, so Shift+Enter works in tools like Claude Code
Mouse reporting, hyperlinks, input methods and bracketed paste
